items.statement: Within the methyl-truncated implicit-solvent model, C[2]BNDI supports the paper's qualitative claim of comparatively strong CPL potential when the submitted |g_lum| result and validated S1 dipole analysis are considered together.

items.statement: The conclusion is bounded to the methyl-truncated molecular model and computational CPL endpoint, not an unconditional prediction of experimental performance.
